{{Quote|The racers are entering the city of Pixelito! And with hometown racer Sebulba the Dug in the lead, the crowd goes wild!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]], announcing the Vinta Harvest Classic|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14">[[Star Wars (1998) 14|''Star Wars'' (1998) 14]]</ref>}}
'''Pixelito''' was the capital city of the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. It was home to most of the planet's native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]], because they were banished from elsewhere on the planet by the [[Gran/Legends|Grans]]. Pixelito was the staging ground of the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]]. Its spaceport was [[Port Pixelito]].

The [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] was from Pixelito.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" />
